title: VTC — shared community presentation definitions
description: Shared types for vtc/community/{branding,requested-attributes,join-discovery}/*: how a community asks to be shown to a prospective applicant, what it asks an applicant to tell it about themselves, and whether it answers its join manifest to a caller it cannot identify. `CommunityBranding` and `RequestedAttribute` are copied member for member from vtc/join-requests/manifest/0.2, which publishes both to applicants; the manifest's own copies are that task's local definitions and re-pinning them here is an editorial follow-up. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

CommunityBranding.title: CommunityBranding
CommunityBranding.description: OPTIONAL. How the community asks to be shown to a prospective applicant: a name, an accent colour and a logo. Presentation only, self-asserted and unverified — `communityDid` identifies the community, never `branding`. Not part of any criterion, so not covered by a `requirementsDigest`. Every member is optional.

displayName.description: The community's name as it asks to be shown.

accentColor.description: An sRGB colour as `#rrggbb`, compared case-insensitively. A community SHOULD write it in lower case.

logoUrl.description: An https URL of the community's logo. Fetched by the client, so an untrusted image from wherever it points.

type.description: A claim-type token from the persona claim-type registry (persona/_shared/0.1/CLAIM-TYPES.md) — `name.display`, `address.country` — or an `x:` extension token.

required.description: False for an attribute the applicant may decline. A submission missing a required one is refused with vtc/join-requests/submit:attributesMissing.

purpose.description: Why the community asks, in words shown to the applicant before they disclose.

RequestedAttributes.title: RequestedAttributes
RequestedAttributes.description: What the community asks an applicant to tell it about themselves, as claim types — never values. At most 32 entries, and no claim type twice: two answers to one question is a question nobody can answer. Self-asserted by the applicant when answered; a community MUST NOT describe an answer as verified. Empty means the community asks nothing.

JoinDiscovery.title: JoinDiscovery
JoinDiscovery.description: Whether this community answers vtc/join-requests/manifest to a caller it cannot identify.

public.description: True: the manifest is answered to any caller, identified or not — the setting of every community that never chose, because the manifest is a public read by design (an applicant has to know what is asked of them before they disclose anything). False: the manifest is answered only to a caller the community can identify — one with a verified proof or a transport-authenticated sender. Not secrecy: an identified caller is answered either way. False makes the answer attributable, which is what a closed or invite-only community wants rather than a crawler enumerating its criteria.
